techniques.label: parallel-b-standard-44-techniques
techniques.observations: All216 production-color frames actually inspected in six native paired sheets: nine equipped techniques, front/side, twelve times each. Lightning strike/pulse/breaker, fire pulse, open wound, intercept, aegis, purify and signature keep the small beak, lower face, eyes, crest, wings, belly, legs and tail coherent through windup, motion and recovery. Opposite side is visible in companion side capture.
